**Observation Log:**

- [PREFERENCE] User is thinking of trying out a new recipe for rustic Italian bread.
- [PREFERENCE] User made a delicious whole wheat baguette last Saturday.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering using whole wheat flour for the rustic Italian bread recipe.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips for achieving a crispy crust on rustic Italian bread, including using high-protein flour, long fermentation time, steam, high oven temperature, scoring the bread, drying the dough, baking with a stone, and cooling on a wire rack.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering using a higher protein flour for the Italian bread recipe.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant confirmed that the convection setting on the oven can help with browning and crisping the crust, but advised caution regarding over-browning and uneven browning.
- [PREFERENCE] User has had good results with the convection setting on their oven, particularly when baking cookies last Thursday.
- [PREFERENCE] User is thinking of trying a slower rise for the Italian bread recipe.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering using their sourdough starter instead of commercial yeast to add more complexity to the flavor.
- [EVENT] User had some experience with sourdough starters.
- [EVENT] User's last attempt at making bread with sourdough starter did not turn out well; the dough didn't rise as expected, and the bread was dense and heavy.
- [TEMPORAL] User tried out a new bread recipe using sourdough starter on Tuesday.
- [CHANGE] User thinks they need to work on their sourdough starter's health and may adjust the recipe.
- [PREFERENCE] User is willing to give sourdough another try for the Italian bread recipe.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips on creating a preferment using sourdough starter, including feeding the starter, mixing the preferment ingredients, resting, fermenting, and adding the preferment to the main dough.
